name: Long March 2C (Ph.3, two-stage)

cd.note: transferred from LM-3B fit (same 3.35 m YF-21C/YF-24 CALT core; LM-2C = LM-3 minus stage 3 per huijiwiki), see fixed_params

propellant_kg.note: S1 propellant 173 t (World Launch Vehicles 2nd ed. 2007 via huijiwiki)

dry_kg.derived: huijiwiki S1 mass 183 t - propellant 173 t

thrust_vac_N.derived: SL 2962 kN x YF-20 vac/SL thrust ratio 816.3/731.5 (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/YF-20), same method as lm4b.json

isp_vac_s.derived: SL Isp 260.8 s (2556 m/s, huijiwiki) x same ratio, so mdot unchanged from the published SL pair

cutoff_s.note: typical sequence: 一级发动机关机 146.5 s

separation_s.note: typical sequence: 一二级分离 148.0 s

ignition_s.assumption: ignition at S1/S2 separation (only separation published)

cutoff_s.note: typical sequence: 二级主机关机 338.1 s

separation_s.note: typical sequence: 星箭分离 545.7 s (payload separation)

cutoff_s.note: typical sequence: 二级游机关机 542.7 s

mass_kg.assumption: not published (3350M/3350L/4200C types exist; type for this flight unknown)

jettison_time_s.note: typical sequence: 整流罩分离 161.3 s

vertical_rise_s.note: typical sequence: 程序转弯 15 s

cd.derived: FITTED LM-3B value transferred (same 3.35 m CALT hypergolic core); filled at run time from vehicles/lm3b.json fitted_family

payload_kg.basis: upper bound LM-2C Ph.3 LEO capability 4.7 t (huijiwiki); payload unknown

header_notes: LM-2C TIMELINE mode: Ph.3 stage data (World Launch Vehicles 2nd ed. 2007) + CALT TYPICAL flight sequence from huijiwiki; all event times hard constraints. Typical sequence, not this flight's.
